title: Battery tools return surface-typed data for bricks surface cards
goal: NERV renders FPVBuddy's battery data as a 🧱 bricks surface card in chat
acceptance: Each tool meant for chat returns structured data with a surface type from the bricks genUI catalogue, validated by a spec against the `@voidbrain/bricks` surface schemas (bricks:F-002-T02, the four surfaces with their schemas), not NERV's shared/surface.ts
A surface type bricks lacks is a bricks proposal, named here
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: mapping two or three tools to existing surface types. Acceptance changed 2026-11-26 to validate against the bricks schemas (cross-project audit proposal 8, accepted by the owner in chat 2026-11-26 ("accept all 17 proposals")). Not a measurement.
